name: rokctapp_composer
description: Configuration list of active SDKs for paas_driver

sdks.name: base_sdk
sdks._comment: Shared kernel (replaces retired core_sdk); provides the app shell templates.

sdks.name: auth_sdk
sdks._comment: Fully installed (skip_install lifted, plan M3, mirrors manager.json): auth_sdk is the source of truth for auth. Its route shells generate LoginRoute/RegisterRoute/etc. - the host's own auth pages are deleted in the same commit, so there is no duplicate-route collision. delivery_sdk's app_type.driver session_policy (deliveryman -> /home, '*' fallback -> /become-driver keeping the session) gates login via the installed auth_session_policy.dart shell.

sdks.name: calc_sdk
sdks._comment: Standalone calculator (productivity PR #4); un-gated /calc route, shared by manager and driver.

sdks.name: revenue_sdk
sdks._comment: Driver income/statistics pages, under a driver/ role folder with an app_type.driver manifest block. Shared with manager.json, which takes the manager variant from the same SDK.

sdks.name: merchants_sdk
sdks._comment: Story UI the driver app shows; base_sdk already owns story_data/story_request, so only the presentation needed a home.

sdks.name: products_sdk
sdks._comment: restaurant_item / product_item / maps_list widgets used by the driver app.
